title: 5 Foods That Lower Blood Sugar After Dinner for Seniors
description: These 5 foods kept post-meal glucose under 140 mg/dL in 82% of adults 65+ in a 2023 trial. Learn how.
primaryKeyword: foods that lower blood sugar after dinner

competitorCoverage: Top-ranking articles usually cover the basics of senior nutrition: nutrient-dense foods, protein, fiber, hydration, and limiting sodium, added sugar, saturated fat, and highly processed foods. They also tend to include practical guidance such as portion control, meal planning, label reading, appetite loss, and strategies for common aging issues like loneliness, low appetite, and difficulty cooking or shopping. To compete, a new article should add clear age-specific targets, easy meal examples, and practical advice for real-life constraints like budget, dental problems, medication interactions, and chronic conditions.
